title: Check eligibility
subtitle: Ask a payer whether a patient is covered. The answer comes back in two parts: whether we got an answer at all, and what they said.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Nphies grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

form.fillNoPreviousCheck: No previous check for that patient ID — fill the identity block by hand.

blockers.provider: choose the provider you are acting for
blockers.payer: choose the payer you are asking

result.verdictBlank: No verdict yet — the payer has not answered.
result.notInForceReason: Why the policy is not in force
result.noCoverages: The payer returned no coverages for this patient.

detail.title: Eligibility response
detail.subtitle: What the payer said, and every policy this patient holds. Choosing a policy is choosing which member ID an authorization is raised under.

raise.pickPrompt: Pick the policy to raise the authorization under.

blockers.noCoverages: the payer returned no coverage for this patient
blockers.pickCoverage: pick one of the policies above
blockers.noMemberId: that policy carries no member ID, and an authorization is raised under one

list.title: Eligibility checks
list.subtitle: Every check run against a payer, newest first. The window below is what you are looking at — remove it to see everything.

window.removed: No date window — showing every check on record

empty.title: No checks match
empty.hint: Nothing on record matches these filters.
empty.hintWindowed: Nothing matches these filters inside the date window above. Widen it or remove it to look further back.
